I couldn't run NAS-Bench-201 here, so these 30 hypotheses come from reasoning about the search space and are untested.

I applied three rules. Adding a strong op (especially `nor_conv_3x3`) gains less when the parent already has a conv on a competing or same edge. Replacing a weak op (`none`, `avg_pool_3x3`) with something useful gains more. Removing a strong op hurts more than removing a redundant one.
